{\"policy\":\"legacy\",\"minimumIterations\":1},\"schedule\":{},\"createdAt\":1,\"updatedAt\":2}],\"otherProjects\":[]}\nUsage: mc

pjam cloud eval run [options]

Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run
it. The upload-
and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not per request (raise it\nwith the global --timeout <ms>); --wait-timeout bounds the RUN

instead.

Options:
 --suite <id-or-name> Eval suite name or ID
 --file <path>
Versioned suite file to upload and run (.yaml or .json, or - for stdin)\n --project <id-or-name> Project na
me or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)\n --server <id-or-name...> Override the suite's saved s
erver selection (HTTP servers only)\n --environment <id-or-name...> Attached project environment(s) to run. Several v
alues start one PAID RUN each.\n --client <id-or-name...> Attached client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with
that client's config. Several values start one PAID RUN each.\n --host <id-or-name...> Deprecated alias for --
client. NOT the host-compat catalog id `mcpjam tools --host` takes.\n --all-targets Run EVERY attache
d environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one PAID RUN per target\n --iterations <n> Run each c
ase this many times under verdict policy 2 (1-10)\n --repetitions <n> Legacy spelling of --iterations\n
--case <id-or-title...> Run only these cases instead of the whole suite\n --exclude-skills
Run the 'without skills' arm: no skills are pinned, and the run is labelled as excluded\n --refresh-snapshot
PERSISTS a new host-config snapshot on the suite, changing every future run of it. Single-target runs only.\n --notes <te
xt> Free-text note stored on the run\n --min-pass-rate <n> Pass threshold for th
is run (0-100)\n --match-options <json> Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. '{\"toolCallOrder\":\"exact
\"}'\n --idempotency-key <key> Retry key for a lost launch response; for --file, one is minted and printed when
omitted\n --wait Wait for every started run to reach a terminal status\n --wait-timeout <ms>
Maximum time to wait for completion (default 600000; a run held for its judge gets up to 31 more minutes un
less this flag is set)\n --reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Render the completed run report to stdout\n --out <path>
Atomically write the completed report selected by --reporter (default: json-summary)\n --compose-client
<id-or-name> Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved environment: the client it runs as. Default is EPHEMERAL
(does not attach to the suite).\n --compose-host <id-or-name> Deprecated alias for --compose-client\n --compose-c
omputer <id-or-name> Sandbox image to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-model <id...> Model(s) to
run on the composed stack. Replaces the client default unless --with-client-default is set.\n --compose-model-selection <json...
> A whole saved model selection (source, connection, settings.reasoningEffort) as JSON (or @file, or -): one cell for its mo
del, at its effort. Alongside --compose-model. Repeat it to add several selections for one model (e.g. at low and at high) — each
distinct selection is its own cell.\n --with-client-default Also launch an inherit cell that uses each client
's pinned model, alongside --compose-model\n --save-targets Attach the composed environments to the su
ite (append, capped at 10). Default is ephemeral.\n --compose-server <id-or-name...> Server(s) to pin on the composed st
ack. Snapshots them into a server group, so the run keeps testing these servers even if the host's own server list changes later.
Mutually exclusive with --compose-server-group.\n --compose-server-group <id> Standalone server group to pin on the
composed stack\n --compose-host-servers No longer supported: eval runs take their servers from a server group
. Use --compose-server or --compose-server-group.\n --compose-skill <id...> Project-shared skill IDs to pin on
the composed stack\n --compose-secret <id...> Project SECRET IDs the composed stack grants to its runs. Without
one a composed stack carries no credential — list them with `mcpjam secrets list`.\n1566:### `cloud eval create`\n1879:that names
